text:
priya: Quick thread to nail the alpha gate for the "Optimize Suggestor" (batching + prefix cache + quant recs + eval-sentry). Need a short, customer-friendly pilot definition.
sam: Alpha should be conservative: read-only recommendations in Console + eval alerts to webhook + per-route opt-out. No auto-apply.
elena: Agree. Also propose a "noise-floor" policy: alerts suppressed if the metric variance is high or sample count < 50. That prevents noisy accounts from getting spammed.
marc: Engineering: we can ship a light-weight trace sampler (configurable %) and a cache simulator. Quant recs will be confidence-scored estimates (not applied). We'll attach delta_estimate + confidence to each rec.
will: Ops: add runbook requirement. If a customer applies a rec and p95 increases >15% or error_rate >1%, ops should run the rollback CLI and page on-call. For alpha, we document manual rollback only.
priya: Pilot checklist draft:
- Console: per-route recs with short "why" and confidence
- Eval-sentry: webhook alerts with debounce + noise-floor (see elena)
- Per-route metadata flag: `optimize_suggestor=off` respected
- Telemetry: batch_size_p50/p95, cache_hit_rate, quant_confidence exposed
- CSV export of recs for customers to review
sam: Debounce + noise-floor rules idea: alert if (a) >=3 failing evals within 72h AND (b) rolling sample_n >= 50 AND (c) metric delta > 2 sigma for 6h. Otherwise suppress. Include reason_code.
elena: Also include a "preview" mode where customers can run the suggester against a small synthetic eval set to see expected alerts before opting-in. Useful for noisy workloads.
marc: Perf testing: three profiles (short_chat, long_doc, streaming). For alpha we run simulated quant (fp16/int8) estimates; record p50/p95/p99, token_savings_est, and eval_delta.
will: Monitoring: add an "advisor-impact" dashboard tile showing before/after p95 and cache_hit_rate; ops needs a quick link to traces.
priya: Privacy: alert payload should include hashed_prompt_id and link to console traces. Raw prompts stored only per account retention setting; default 30d.
sam: Customer ask: BetaCorp needs per-route pin to prevent quant (they're sensitive). We'll support `no_quant=true` in metadata for alpha.
elena: Docs: include rollback CLI snippet and an explanation of confidence scores and delta_estimate. Example rollback:
```
# disable suggestor on route
redwood routes patch my-route --metadata '{"optimize_suggestor":"off"}'
```
marc: Timeline: sampler prototype (3d), console rec list UI (5d), eval-webhook + debounce (4d), docs + preview mode (4d). Alpha run 14 days with 3 pilot customers.
priya: Sign-off criteria alpha->beta: no customer-reported P0 regressions; at least 2/3 pilots show meaningful cache_hit_rate uplift (>15%) on recommended routes OR a remediation plan.
will: Risk note: bad quant recs -> downstream quality regressions. Mitigation: require A/B guardrail and owner acknowledgement before applying quant. Provide dry-run telemetry mode.
sam: Action items: sam confirm pilots (2d), marc prototype sampler (3d), elena draft noise-floor + webhook schema (3d), will draft rollback runbook + dashboard tile (4d), priya coordinate sign-off.
priya: Sounds good. Reconvene in 48h with status updates. :thumbsup:
notif-bot: deploy: branch optimize-suggestor/alpha -> staged; smoke tests queued :gear:
